name: MonarchErrorState
title: ErrorState
summary: A region failed to load: what failed, why in plain words, and a retry button, in the layout of MonarchEmptyState.
whenToUse: When a screen, a panel or a large card could not load its content and there is nothing else to show in its place.
whenNotToUse: For a small part of a screen, use MonarchInlineErrorRetry. For an empty result that is not a failure, use MonarchEmptyState. For a form error, use field errors.
api: @Composable fun MonarchErrorState(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, kind: MonarchErrorStateKind = MonarchErrorStateKind.Error, size: MonarchEmptyStateSize = MonarchEmptyStateSize.Md, retrying: Boolean = false, message: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, requestId: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, retryLabel: String? = null, retryingLabel: String? = null, requestIdLabel: String? = null)
enum class MonarchErrorStateKind { Error, Forbidden, NotFound, Offline, Server, Maintenance }

options.name: title
options.description: What failed. Marked as a heading.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the error state.

options.name: kind
options.description: What went wrong: the tile color and whether retry is offered.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm, Md or Lg, shared with MonarchEmptyState.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows the retry button as busy; it ignores taps.

options.name: message
options.description: Why, in plain words, and what the user can do.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon in a tinted tile. Hidden from TalkBack; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: requestId
options.description: The request id of the failed response, selectable so it can be copied.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a primary retry button, except for Forbidden and NotFound.

options.name: actions
options.description: Further buttons after the retry button.

options.name: retryLabel
options.description: Label of the retry button. null uses monarch_errorstate_retry, "Try again".

options.name: retryingLabel
options.description: State of the retry button while retrying. null uses monarch_errorstate_retrying, "Retrying".

options.name: requestIdLabel
options.description: Label before the request id. null uses monarch_errorstate_request_id, "Request ID".

states.name: error, server
states.description: The tile in the danger tint; retry is offered.

states.name: offline
states.description: The tile in the warning tint; retry is offered.

states.name: maintenance
states.description: A muted tile; retry is offered.

states.name: forbidden, not found
states.description: A muted tile and no retry button, even when onRetry is given.

states.name: retrying
states.description: A progress indicator in the retry button, which ignores taps and reports "Retrying" as its state.

appearance: The layout and type of MonarchEmptyState. The icon tile is the danger subtle background with the danger strong icon for Error and Server, the warning pair for Offline, and the muted background with muted icon for Forbidden, NotFound and Maintenance. The request id is a muted caption with the id in the code typeface and default text color.
platformNotes: The web has a copy button beside the request id; here the id is in a SelectionContainer, so it is copied with the system text selection, and Monarch does not write to the clipboard. Further actions are a slot where iOS takes one title and closure. The web errorKindFromStatus helper is not offered. The busy state is always controlled with retrying. The web sets role=alert; here the state does not announce itself, as on iOS. Monarch bundles no icons, so the app passes the icon the web chooses by kind.
accessibility: The title is marked as a heading; the icon tile is hidden from TalkBack. Title and message say what failed, so nothing depends on the icon or its color.
While retrying the retry button stays in the focus order, ignores taps and has the state "Retrying".
The request id is one element, read as its label, a colon and the id, and can be selected and copied.
Buttons reserve 48dp touch targets and wrap at large font sizes.
The state does not announce itself when it replaces content.
edgeCases: onRetry is ignored for Forbidden and NotFound, because a retry cannot change the outcome.
A long request id wraps inside the text.

examples.title: Error with retry and request id
examples.webExample: Error with retry and request id
examples.code:
MonarchErrorState(
    title = "Couldn't load invoices",
    message = "Check your connection and try again.",
    requestId = "req_7f3a91c2",
    onRetry = {},
)

examples.title: No access
examples.code:
MonarchErrorState(
    title = "You do not have access to this report",
    kind = MonarchErrorStateKind.Forbidden,
    message = "Ask an admin of the workspace for access.",
)
